library.name: Brittney - Relaxing, Calm and Meditative
library.description: A calm and relaxing female voice, ideal for meditation and self-reflection. The tone is smooth and measured, painting a clear picture for the listener with a youthful, vibrant voice.

raw_source_gate.method:
Raw source-quality gate for Brittney (BEFORE any gain, limiting, denoise,
transcode or mastering), measured by the SAME code as the 2026-10-14 gate
(raw_source_gate.analyse, pause_floor.pause_runs, the grace_pauses 20 dB rule,
pace.WORDS) against all six reference voices. Writes only into brittney/;
the earlier replacements/*.json reports are left untouched.
Usage: python -I brittney_gate.py <repo>

perceptual_noise.method:
Perceptual re-analysis of the raw pause noise (2026-10-16 methodology fix).
Untouched raw MP3s, all nine voices, each scaled by ONE linear gain so its
five-clip listening take reads -22 LUFS (the matched listening level of the
approved masters). Within the speech span, the inter-word pauses (20 dB rule,
runs >= 120 ms, edges dropped) are pooled and analysed with a Welch PSD
(2048-point Hann, 21.5 Hz bins) instead of 20 ms unweighted frame RMS:
 - unweighted level, A-weighted level (IEC 61672 curve), and band-limited
   levels: <20 Hz (DC / sub), 20-100, 100-150, >100, >150, 150-4000, >4000 Hz;
 - DC offset of the pause samples;
 - the dominant low-frequency peak (is it a tone or a broad rumble?);
 - octave-band levels so the bed spectrum can be compared voice by voice.
All levels are dBFS at matched listening level (or dB(A)FS for A-weighted).
No threshold is set here; this is diagnostic evidence for listening.
Usage: python -I perceptual_noise.py <repo> <out.json>

result_before_final_approval: FOUNDER LISTENING PASS (2026-10-16); measurement flag: low-frequency (sub-bass ~32 Hz) residual under investigation

founder_decision.basis: Founder listened to the restrained mastered validation (brittney_listen_mastered.m4a) and approved Brittney for production.
founder_decision.superseded: The earlier automatic raw-noise FAIL was a false positive caused by unweighted measurement of primarily ~32 Hz sub-bass energy. The founder heard no perceptible noise. The perceptual analysis (perceptual_noise.json) and founder listening judgement supersede it.
